articles.title: Coinbase Eyes In-House Prediction Markets in First Half 2027
articles.summary: Coinbase is building its own prediction markets platform and plans to launch it in the first half of 2027. If they actually ship it, we're looking at a major liquidity inflow to onchain prediction markets from one of crypto's largest retail gateways.

articles.title: Michigan Forced Polymarket to Retreat. Did the State Expose Prediction Markets' Weak Spot?
articles.summary: Michigan's regulators forced Polymarket to block residents from using their platform, testing whether states can weaponize gambling laws to crush prediction markets before they go mainstream. If other states follow suit, we're looking at a patchwork of regional bans that could balkanize the entire industry before it ever gets legitimacy.

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Prediction Markets: Ezra Frech Favorite for Finale
articles.summary: Ezra Frech, the Paralympic athlete turned reality TV competitor, is the betting favorite to win this season of Dancing With the Stars. His odds advantage suggests the market's pricing in both his athletic coordination and the sympathy bias that typically propels athlete contestants toward finale appearances.

articles.title: Kalshi Asks States for Help in Restricting Problem Gamblers
articles.summary: Kalshi's lobbying states to implement tighter restrictions on problem gamblers, essentially asking regulators to do the heavy lifting on consumer protection so the platform doesn't have to. If states actually follow through, prediction market operators face higher compliance costs and a smaller addressable market, but also get to point at "responsible gambling" measures when regulators come knocking.

articles.title: Are Prediction Markets the Future of Finance?
articles.summary: Prediction markets are getting pitched as the next big thing in financial infrastructure, with backers claiming they'll eventually replace traditional forecasting methods. If true, that means serious money flows into volume and liquidity for the platforms that nail user experience and regulatory compliance first.

articles.title: Polymarket Indicates 29% Chance Anthropic’s Market Cap Lands Above $1.5 Trillion
articles.summary: Polymarket traders are betting there's a 29% shot Anthropic reaches a $1.5T valuation, a figure that would put the AI startup in rarefied air alongside only Apple, Saudi Aramco, and Microsoft. That low probability reflects deep skepticism about whether Claude can actually convert hype into the kind of sustained revenue dominance needed to justify a valuation 3x higher than current unicorn pricing.

articles.title: Polymarket upgrades new $25 referral code “OREGON” for Jazz-Lakers NBA
articles.summary: Polymarket rolled out a $25 referral bonus using code "OREGON" ahead of the Jazz-Lakers game, signaling the platform's bet on NBA content to drive user acquisition. Expect prediction market platforms to weaponize sports events as onramps now that crypto betting's regulatory uncertainty has cleared enough to justify marketing spend.

articles.title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction market platform that's been pushing the boundaries of what's legally tradeable in the U.S., just lost another court battle, with an appellate court siding against their expansion efforts. The ruling adds another brick to the regulatory wall that could keep prediction markets confined to their current narrow lane while competitors eyeing mainstream adoption sweat it out in legal limbo.

articles.title: Video: Executives Discuss the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling
articles.summary: Executives are apparently drawing lines in the sand between prediction markets (legitimate!) and gambling (sketchy!), which means the regulatory conversation is heating up. If they nail a legal distinction, it could unlock billions in mainstream money that's currently sitting on the sidelines waiting for official permission.

articles.title: Zohran Mamdani says prediction markets are troubling and 'degrade so much of life'
articles.summary: A New York state legislator is arguing that prediction markets commodify human outcomes in ways that are fundamentally corrosive to society. The comment signals growing political pushback that could translate into actual regulatory constraints on the industry just as it's gaining mainstream adoption.

articles.title: Polymarket Founder Says Trump Jr.’s Involvement Is ‘Heavily Overblown’
articles.summary: Polymarket's founder is pushing back on claims that Don Trump Jr. has significant influence over the platform's operations and decision-making. The clarification matters because regulatory scrutiny of prediction markets often hinges on perceived conflicts of interest, and any real or imagined political entanglement could invite unwanted attention from lawmakers already skeptical of crypto betting platforms.

articles.title: How to Play META Stock as Meta Platforms Tests a New Prediction Markets App
articles.summary: Meta's building a prediction markets app, which means the company that owns Facebook and Instagram is finally taking a swing at the space. If they nail distribution and liquidity, they could either legitimize the entire category or accidentally kill it by turning it into another algorithmic engagement machine.
